plan.title: Make the npm deposit Python-free and prove it with a greenfield smoke (Phase 3)

narratives.Description: The @deftai/directive-content prepack still bundles the scripts/ tree (added by #1984) and the deposit can still contain .py files and a repo-root run shim. This story stops the prepack from bundling Python and verifies a greenfield directive init plus task check on a machine with no Python installed. It depends on Phases 1 and 2 because the deposit can only drop Python once nothing on the consumer path still calls it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Update the @deftai/directive-content prepack so it no longer bundles scripts/ or any other Python-only tree, and ensure directive init and update produce a deposit with no .py files and no repo-root run shim.
- Add a greenfield smoke check that runs directive init and task check in a Python-free environment and asserts a clean pass.
narratives.UserStory: As a new user installing directive, I want a Python-free deposit, so that init and task check succeed on a machine with no Python installed.
